params.name: elementRef
params.description: Root XML element reference to export

params.name: filePath
params.description: Full access path of the file to create/overwrite; if only a file name is given (no path), the file is searched for, or created, next to the structure file

sentinelValues.meaning: displays a standard save/open file dialog box for the user to choose the destination

overloads.semanticRole: Saves an XML tree to a file on disk, creating the file if it doesn't already exist.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

constraints: On export, internal LF line breaks are replaced by CRLF on Windows (no replacement on macOS); use an XML CDATA element (or the "" entity) to preserve literal carriage returns.
Files are written without a BOM by default; line-ending and BOM behavior are controlled via XML SET OPTIONS (compatibility note: pre-v19.x databases default to CR line endings on macOS and a BOM).
